name: Beef grilled in lá lốt
summary: Beef wrapped in lá lốt and grilled. Báo Quốc tế says it may include mỡ chài, and lists lettuce, basil, fish mint, green banana, cucumber, star fruit, and mắm nêm.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế says people here name bò nướng lá lốt, bò lá lốt, and thịt bò lá lốt for the same grilling.
howToEat: Grill beef in lá lốt. Báo Quốc tế says mỡ chài may be added. Eat with lettuce, basil, fish mint, green banana, cucumber, and star fruit, and dip in mắm nêm.
